A named voter guide/Sway voting group is a recommendation, not automatically a formal endorsement. The generic boilerplate combines endorsements and recommendations: use the specific entry and its category. Do not rely on URL filenames alone. Hold ambiguous cases.

criteria.endorsed: The source reports this named entity endorsing this candidate
criteria.recommended: The source reports a voter-guide or recommendation relationship
criteria.distinction: An award, badge or program distinction
criteria.unrelated: Mention, navigation, donor, opponent or reverse endorsement
